projection.projection_goal: Project the skill loading ontology slice into a domain model, validation rules, and prompt constraints for downstream codegen and orchestration.

source_slice.slice_topic: skill loading order, source precedence, and eligibility filtering

concept_mappings.notes: Keep the top-level skills configuration as the aggregate root carrying the system switch, allowBundled, and per-skill entries.
Model the skill definition as the core entity that ultimately enters the eligible skills set, preserving name, location, source, and metadata.
Project source tiers as an enum so overwrite order and same-name precedence remain explicit.

relation_mappings.notes: Preserve the one-way association from SkillDefinition to SkillSource instead of flattening it into a plain string field.

constraint_mappings.notes: Project source precedence as a runtime guard so lower-priority sources cannot overwrite higher-priority ones.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not assume managed or bundled skills automatically have the highest precedence.
Do not collapse source tiers into plain labels that lose precedence semantics.
required_clarifications: If documentation and code disagree on the managed skills path, clarify whether code or docs are the source of truth before proceeding.
source_digest: Conflict note: S1 and S2 differ on managed skill directory wording

dropped_items.reason: This projection only keeps the top-level config, skill definition, and source tier; SkillLoadConfig is not emitted as a standalone artifact yet.

meta.notes: This example is derived from examples/ready/sample.json and shows how a READY slice can be projected into combined domain-model and prompt-policy artifacts.
